prompt: Make one image: a botanical study plate printed as a Jiangnan water-print woodblock on warm xuan paper, at night by lamplight (warm paper, deep ink). Left half: one whole winged maple samara drawn large and flat, the veined wing and the round seed end, in fine carved ink lines with a pale ochre wash. Right half: a large cross-section of the seed end of the samara, as a carved botanical diagram: the outer fruit wall, inside it the seed with two long green cotyledons folded on each other and the small pointed embryonic root at one end, clean ink outlines, flat mineral-green and ochre fills. Below them a thin ruler line with tick marks only. Generous empty paper around the drawings for labels added later. Absolutely no letters, no numbers, no Chinese characters, no labels, no seals, no signatures, no people.
